name: Rekem
overview: The name Rekem appears in Scripture with multiple references, highlighting both a person and a place. Rekem was a king of the Midianites slain by the Israelites during their conquest, as recorded in Numbers 31:8 and Joshua 13:21, emphasizing God's judgment on the enemies of His people. Additionally, Rekem is noted as a son of Hebron in 1 Chronicles 2:43-44, linking him to the genealogies of Israel. Lastly, Rekem is identified as a city within the territory of Benjamin in Joshua 18:27, indicating its place in the settled land. These references collectively show Rekem’s significance in both the history and geography of Israel.
